# Activities and experiences

## Kluane National Park and Reserve

Home to 17 of Canada’s 20 highest peaks, Kluane is known worldwide for its wilderness recreation. Raft past glaciers on the remote Alsek River. Explore high mountain passes on multi-day treks. Or find more accessible adventure at Kathleen Lake, where great hikes await just off the highway. The Thechàl Dhâl Visitor Centre and the Kluane National Park and Reserve Visitor Centre lay out all the options, including thrilling flightseeing for a bird’s-eye view.

Featured


[![Close up view of hiking boots](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/activ/Activities-page-Features/Activities-Feature-Hiking.jpg?modified=20221116061541)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/randonnee-hiking)

### [​Hiking](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/randonnee-hiking)

Kluane's most popular activity. From short strolls to multi-day route-finding adventures, for an hour, a day, or a week, Kluane offers much to expore.

[![A child smiles and carries firewood](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/activ/Features-640-x-360/Activities-Feature-Camping.jpg?modified=20221123032159)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/kathleen)

### [Kathleen Lake](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/kathleen)

Pitch your tent and bask in the legendary midnight sun! Just a short drive from town is Kathleen Lake, where sparkling waters are backed by the Kluane Range.

[![Inside view of Kluane National Park Visitor Centre with topographic map exhibit](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/activ/Activities-page-Features/Activities-Feature-Vis-Centres.jpg?modified=20221116061853)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/info)

### [Visitor centres](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/info)

Explore fascinating exhibits, listen to recordings of traditional stories, and chat with knowledgeable staff at the two park Visitor Centres.

[![Aerial view of mountains and glaciers](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/activ/Activities-page-Features/Activities-Feature-Flightseeing.jpg?modified=20221116061434)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/aeriennes-flightseeing)

### [Flightseeing](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/aeriennes-flightseeing)

Flightseeing tours take you deep into the park’s interior. Fly over the Icefield Ranges and explore Canada’s highest peaks and largest icefields.

[![People in raft on Alsek River](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/activ/Activities-page-Features/Activities-Feature-Alsek.jpg?modified=20221116060255)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alsek)

### [​Rafting the Alsek River](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alsek)

Fed by glacial meltwaters from the world’s second highest coastal mountain range, the Alsek River offers an extraordinary opportunity for wilderness travel.

[![Parka with children outside](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/activ/Activities-page-Features/KNPR-Summer-2-copy.jpg?modified=20230615222454)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/sched-even)

### [Tours and programs](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/sched-even)

Find out what special events are taking place or join a Parks Canada Heritage Presenter to learn about the park or sing songs around a campfire!

## Camping and overnight accommodations

### [Backcountry camping](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/randonnee-hiking)

Explore Kluane's incredible backcountry.

### [Kathleen Lake Campground](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/kathleen)

Camp at scenic Kathleen Lake Campground.

### [oTENTik](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/kathleen/hebergement-accommodation-pcrs)

A cross between a tent and a rustic cabin, Parks Canada oTENTik is a relaxing way to experience camping.

Plan your visit

| | [How to get here](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit) ### Contact us PO Box 5495 Haines Junction YT Y0B 1L0 Email address:[kluaneinfo@pc.gc.ca](mailto:kluaneinfo@pc.gc.ca) Phone numberVisitor Information: 867-634-5134 Phone numberAdministration: 867-634-7250 **24 hour emergency dispatch** Phone number:1-780-852-3100 ### Hours of operation [Haines Junction Visitor Centre](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/info#Daku) **May 15 to September 20** Every day: 9 am to 5 pm [Thechàl Dhâl Visitor Centre](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/info#thech%C3%A0l) **May 20 to September 6** Every day: 10 am to 4 pm [Kathleen Lake Campground](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/services/kathleen#2 "Kathleen Lake Campground") [Overnight registration](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/visit/inscription-registration) ### Social - [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/ParksCanadaYukon/) - [Twitter](https://x.com/ParksCanYukon) ## More places to discover with Parks Canada [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/yt/yt-chilkoot-lhn-nhs-640x360.jpg?modified=20221125212558)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/chilkoot) ### [Chilkoot Trail National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/chilkoot) Hike a legendary trail through the northern Coast Mountains, from Alaska’s Taiya Inlet to the headwaters of the Yukon River in northern British Columbia. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/yt/yt-ss-klondike-lhn-nhs-640x360.jpg?modified=20221125212558)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/ssklondike) ### [S.S. Klondike National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/ssklondike) Steam-powered sternwheelers were the Yukon’s link to the outside world for almost a century. The S.S. Klondike National Historic Site in Whitehorse honours these vessels, so vital to the settlement of the North. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/yt/yt-klondike-lhn-nhs-640x360.jpg?modified=20221125212558)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/klondike) ### [Klondike National Historic Sites](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/klondike) Step back into the days of the 1898 Klondike Gold Rush. Prowl a paddlewheeler. Explore goldfields. Magical Dawson City is a frontier town where history mingles with everyday life. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/yt/yt-vuntut-pn-np-640x360.jpg?modified=20221125212558)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/vuntut) ### [Vuntut National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/vuntut) Explore untouched northern landscapes and learn the story of the Vuntut Gwitchin people and their relationship to the land and animals of the northern Yukon. Dogs are prohibited in this area. Hiking is Kluane's most popular activity. Opportunities range from short strolls to multi-day route-finding adventures. Whether you get out for an hour, a day, or a week, there is much to explore in Kluane. Trailheads can be difficult to get to without a vehicle since there is no public transportation. Areas may be temporarily closed for safety or environmental reasons. Before your hike check: [Trail conditions](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/randonnee-hiking/etat-sentiers-trail-conditions) [Important bulletins](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/bulletins) * * * ### Overnight hikes **Backcountry permits and registration are mandatory** for all overnight use in Kluane National Park and Reserve **between April 1 and November 15**. The use of approved bear-resistant food canisters is mandatory. # Safety and guidelines

## Kluane National Park and Reserve

We rarely head out for an outdoor adventure with the expectation that something will go wrong, and most times everything will go right. However, sometimes the unexpected happens and when it does, it's important that you are well informed and well prepared to minimize the negative impacts of unfortunate circumstances.

For important information about staying safe while enjoying Kluane National Park and Reserve, please explore the topics below.

### Important Bulletins

- [Find a list of warnings, closures and alerts for Kluane National Park and Reserve.](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/bulletins)

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/Saftey-feature---Bears_Elliott.jpg?modified=20170213180910)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/ours-bears)

### [Bear safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/ours-bears)

Kluane is home to both grizzly and black bears. Familiarize yourself with the principles and practices of safe travel in bear country.

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/Safety-backcountry-Mueller.jpg?modified=20170213180807)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/plan)

### [Backcountry safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/plan)

You must be self-sufficient and able to handle emergency situations on your own. Plan ahead and ensure that you are properly equipped.

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/winter-safety-Muellerf.jpg?modified=20170213180924)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/hiver-winter)

### [Winter safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/securite-safety/hiver-winter)

Kluane is a winter wonderland with fun for all! To ensure you have a safe and enjoyable trip, please be prepared!

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/safety-mountaineering-Parks-Canada.jpg?modified=20170213180901)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alpinisme-mountaineering/secur-safe)

### [Mountaineering](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alpinisme-mountaineering/secur-safe)

Mountaineering parties must be entirely self-sufficient and able to handle emergency situations on their own.

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/safety-biking-Mueller.jpg?modified=20170213180841)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/velo-biking#activ5-2)

### [Mountain biking safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/velo-biking\#activ5-2)

Have the ride of your life! Get geared up, be safe on the trails, respect the environment and other trail users.

[![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/yt/kluane/WET4/securite-safety/Safety-rafting-Noel-Hendrickson.jpg?modified=20170213180816)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alsek/hazards)

### [Alsek River safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/yt/kluane/activ/alsek/hazards)

The Alsek is a remote wilderness river, with cold water, powerful rapids and ice floes. Plan ahead and be prepared!

Safety is everyone's responsibility. At Parks Canada, we do our part to make sure you can have a safe visit by assessing the risks, managing hazards, and making sure that safety information is freely available. You can do your part as visitors by making sure you seek out the information you need to stay safe and make well informed decisions while enjoying these special places. Visit our website and stop at a visitor center to speak with our employees for the most up to date information. Make sure you are fully prepared for whatever activities you choose to participate in so you can have a safe, enjoyable and memorable visit.

# Camping

## Kluane National Park and Reserve

Camp at scenic Kathleen Lake Campground, stay in a cozy oTENTik tent, or head out into the backcountry for an unforgettable overnight hiking trip.

### Frontcountry camping

Kathleen Lake is Kluane National Park and Reserve's destination for highway accessible vehicle-based camping.

### Backcountry camping

Overnight backcountry permits/registration and de-registration is mandatory for all overnight use in Kluane National Park and Reserve between April 1 and Novmeber 15. The use of approved bear-resistant food canisters is mandatory.
